rewrites._comment: The SPA catch-all must not swallow the serverless routes. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so /api would probably survive anyway, but the negative lookahead makes it explicit rather than dependent on routing order.

headers._comment: script-src carries no 'unsafe-inline'. The one inline script is the pre-paint theme bootstrap in index.html, pinned by hash instead; a test recomputes that hash and fails if the script is edited without updating this value. style-src does allow 'unsafe-inline', because that same script assigns documentElement.style.colorScheme, which counts as a style attribute. That is a narrow cost: there is no dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere and React escapes all output, so there is no HTML-injection path to exploit it. connect-src is 'self' only, which is possible because the browser talks to /api/schedules rather than to the upstream API directly.
